fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-criminal Record Certificate If applicant is unable to get one at home country, please sign Non-criminal Record Affirmation. International students studying in China can submit a certificate of no bad performance issued by school. You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Letters of recommendation * 3. Statement of Financial Support You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Study Plan(minimum of 800 words with introduction of yourself and your family, reasons for choosing ECUST and the major) 5. Foreigner Physical Examination Form with validity of less than 6 months when submission(applicants for scholarship must submit). You can download a template or sample from here . 6. Additional documents when necessary Applicants in design program should provide at least 1 art work. * 7. Handwriting Signature * 8. Self-introduction (recorded in video) No longer than 3 minutes. * 9. Copy of passport photo page(Valid until Sept. 1st, 2027 and beyond) * 10. A white background ID photo * 11. Transcripts of all high school courses or results of international standardization test (A-LEVEL/IB/ICGSE/AP/SAT/ACT/BC/UEC/STPM etc.) Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 12. Copy of high school diploma or equivalent certificate Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. Prospective diploma recipients must submit an official document issued by the current school to prove the current study status and expected graduation date. If applicants are admitted, a scan copy of the graduation and degree certificate shall be sent before registration. * 13. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 14. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -Note: Bachelor degree JMD programs don't require CSCA. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants holding valid foreign passports and in good health, with a high school degree or above. 2. Be aged over 16, those who are under 18 before August 31 of the application year, please visit Downloadto download and submit GUARANTEE STATEMENT. 3. Comply with the regulations （JW〔2020〕No. 12） issued by Ministry of Education of People’s Republic of China. 4. Applicants should meet the following language requirements English-taught Programs: minimum requirements of TOEFL 80 or IELTS 6.0 or Duolingo 105. Those who can provide English-taught proof for previous degrees or native English speakers do not need to submit the English Proficiency Certificate. 5. CSCA scores are preferred for priority admission, CSCA Test Subjects download here . Note: Tuition of the 3rd year: ECUST Tuition +Estimated International Tuition of £ 32,350
